scripts.build: npm run build -w @pantry-lens/api && npm run build -w @pantry-lens/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @pantry-lens/web && npm run lint -w @pantry-lens/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pantry-lens/api --if-present && npm run test -w @pantry-lens/web --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pantry-lens/api && npm run typecheck -w @pantry-lens/web
